content: I-Doser is an application that claims to utilize binaural beats to simulate the effects of various drugs and altered states of consciousness. Users can purchase specific doses of their choice from an online store. The application then plays these dose files, which are designed to mimic the effects of the selected drug. The effects experienced by the user can vary and are influenced by the individual's mental state at the time of administration as well as the type of dose chosen. The application offers a wide range of doses categorized into stimulants, antidepressants, recreational drugs, and hallucinogens. This phenomenon is based on the discovery of binaural beats by Heinrich Wilhelm Dove, a German neuroscientist, in 1839. Dove proposed that the beat frequency created by two sounds of slightly different frequencies could influence the brain's fundamental state. The doses provided by I-Doser are not addictive, as the effects are described as being extremely subtle. Many first-time users report feeling some effects but are often willing to try again, as achieving noticeable results typically requires 30 to 40 minutes of focused concentration.
